run_datasets_cli: run the HuggingFace datasets CLI tool with a subcommand and optional arguments
run_environment_command: run the environment subcommand to display the current datasets environment information
run_test_command: run the test subcommand to execute dataset tests from the CLI
run_delete_from_hub_command: run the delete-from-hub subcommand to delete a dataset from the HuggingFace Hub
parse_unknown_args: parse unknown CLI arguments into a key-value dictionary by alternating pairs
